rule_name: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
description: Must be enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution. Verify the DLI on the official government list; non-DLI enrolment is ineligible.
evidence_required: LOA + DLI number from the official DLI list
condition: Enrolled at a verified DLI
user_message_if_failed: You must be enrolled at a DLI on the official list. Verify the DLI number at canada.ca before paying any agent.

rule_name: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) Required — Must Be Uploaded Correctly
description: A valid Letter of Acceptance is mandatory and is verified directly with the institution. A fake/unverifiable LOA causes refusal and a misrepresentation finding.
evidence_required: Official LOA uploaded in the correct section
condition: Holds a valid, verifiable LOA
user_message_if_failed: A valid LOA from a DLI is mandatory and will be checked with your school. Upload it in the correct section.

rule_name: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
description: Applicant must satisfy the officer they are a genuine student who will leave Canada at the end of authorised stay (dual intent permitted). Assessed via the Letter of Explanation/study plan, provable home ties, and study-plan logic — Canada has no Australian-style 'GS form'.
evidence_required: Letter of Explanation, evidence of ties (property/employment/family), credible study plan
condition: Officer satisfied applicant is bona fide and will leave on expiry
user_message_if_failed: Weak ties and generic study plans are the top Pakistani refusal reasons. Make your Letter of Explanation specific and back ties with documents.

rule_name: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) or Territorial Attestation Letter (TAL) Required
description: Most post-secondary applicants must submit a PAL/TAL with the application (international student cap, Jan 2024). From 2026-01-01, Masters/doctoral students at public DLIs are exempt. Must be submitted WITH the application.
evidence_required: PAL or TAL from the province
condition: Holds a valid PAL/TAL where required, submitted with application
user_message_if_failed: Submit your PAL/TAL with the application or it will be returned. Confirm whether you are exempt.

rule_name: Quebec Applicants Need Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ)
description: Quebec study requires a Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ) before/with the federal permit. Quebec also applies higher financial thresholds from 2026.
evidence_required: Valid CAQ from Quebec
condition: Holds a complete CAQ
user_message_if_failed: Quebec applicants need a complete CAQ. Apply to Quebec first; no CAQ means you cannot proceed for Quebec.

rule_name: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
description: Must prove funds for tuition, living, and return transport without working. Outside Quebec, single-applicant living cost = CAD 22,895 from 2025-09-01 (LICO-indexed; CAD 28,502 for 2, CAD 35,040 for 3). Quebec is higher. Funds must be genuine, accessible, and (typically) supported by ~4 months of statements.
evidence_required: Bank statements (4+ months), loan/scholarship letters, GIC, source-of-funds proof
condition: Funds >= living cost + first-year tuition + transport (+dependants), genuine and accessible
user_message_if_failed: Insufficient or unexplained funds is a top refusal reason. Show CAD 22,895 living + tuition + transport, held consistently, with every major deposit documented. Verify the current figure before applying.

rule_name: Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) Still Accepted as Financial Evidence
description: SDS ended 8 Nov 2024, but a GIC from a participating bank (CIBC, BMO, Scotiabank, RBC, TD, National Bank) is still accepted as financial evidence in the regular stream. A GIC alone is not enough — tuition and transport must also be evidenced.
evidence_required: GIC certificate from a participating institution
condition: GIC from participating bank, plus tuition/transport evidence
user_message_if_failed: A GIC strengthens your file but does not replace tuition and transport evidence.

rule_name: Educational Consistency and Study-Plan Logic (Bona Fide-linked)
description: Education/employment history should be consistent and logically connected to the chosen program; 12+ month gaps and drastic field changes must be justified. Academic documents should be verifiable/attested (HEC/IBCC) with certified translations.
applies_to: Applicants with gaps, field changes, or unverified academics
evidence_required: Attested transcripts/degrees, employment letters covering gaps, study-plan justification
condition: Education path consistent or any gap/switch evidenced
user_message_if_failed: Unexplained gaps over a year or a drastic field switch will be probed. Provide attested transcripts and documented justification.

rule_name: Medical Exam Required for Stays of 6+ Months
description: An immigration medical exam by an IRCC-approved panel physician is required for stays of 6+ months. Pakistani applicants typically need TB (chest X-ray) screening.
evidence_required: IME by an IRCC panel physician
condition: IME completed at an approved panel physician
user_message_if_failed: Complete your IME with an IRCC panel physician. Reports from non-panel local clinics are worthless for the permit.

rule_name: Biometrics Required for Most Applicants Aged 14–79
description: Biometrics are required for most applicants aged 14–79, given at a Visa Application Centre after the Biometrics Instruction Letter is issued.
evidence_required: Biometrics at a VAC + fee
condition: Biometrics fee paid and biometrics given
user_message_if_failed: Pay the biometrics fee and complete biometrics at a VAC promptly after receiving your BIL.

rule_name: Student Direct Stream (SDS) Ended — November 8, 2024
description: The Student Direct Stream ended 8 Nov 2024. All applicants use the regular study permit stream; there is no fast GIC+language shortcut.
evidence_required: Regular stream application
condition: Understands SDS is closed
user_message_if_failed: There is no SDS fast-track anymore. Prepare a full regular-stream application.

rule_name: Changing Schools Requires a New Study Permit (From November 8, 2024)
description: From 8 Nov 2024, changing DLI requires applying for and being approved a new study permit before switching.
evidence_required: New study permit application
condition: Holds new permit before switching DLI
user_message_if_failed: You cannot just switch schools — apply for a new study permit first.

rule_name: Off-Campus Work Limited to 24 Hours Per Week
description: Off-campus work is limited to 24 hours per week while the program is in session (full-time during scheduled breaks); work can only start once studies begin.
evidence_required: Awareness; compliance
condition: Understands and complies with the 24-hour limit
user_message_if_failed: Working over 24 hrs/week during sessions breaches your permit and risks status.

rule_name: Spousal Open Work Permit Now Restricted to Masters (16+ Months) and Doctoral Students
description: From 21 Jan 2025, spousal open work permits are mainly limited to spouses of Masters (16+ months)/doctoral students and certain select programs.
applies_to: Spouses of students wishing to work
evidence_required: Eligible program proof
condition: Program qualifies for spousal OWP
user_message_if_failed: Spousal OWP is now restricted; confirm your program qualifies before relying on your spouse working.

rule_name: PGWP Requires PGWP-Eligible DLI and Qualifying Field of Study (Non-Degree Programs)
description: PGWP requires a PGWP-eligible DLI and, for non-degree programs, a qualifying field of study (CIP linked to labour needs).
evidence_required: PGWP-eligible DLI/program; field check for non-degree
condition: Program/DLI is PGWP-eligible
user_message_if_failed: Confirm PGWP eligibility (DLI and, for diplomas, field of study) before enrolling.

rule_name: Authorized Leave Cannot Exceed 150 Days
description: Authorized leave from studies cannot exceed 150 days; longer without authorisation risks loss of status.
evidence_required: Awareness; compliance
condition: Does not exceed 150 days leave
user_message_if_failed: Do not pause studies beyond 150 days without authorisation.

rule_name: Must Apply to Extend Study Permit Before It Expires
description: Must apply to extend the study permit before it expires to keep maintained status.
evidence_required: Extension application before expiry
condition: Applies to extend before expiry
user_message_if_failed: Apply to extend at least 30 days before your permit expires.

rule_name: Immigration History and Full Disclosure
description: All prior visa refusals, cancellations, overstays, and asylum claims (any country) must be disclosed and, where relevant, explained. Prior refusals are visible to IRCC and weighed in the bona-fide assessment; non-disclosure is misrepresentation under A40.
evidence_required: Full disclosure of immigration history; explanation of prior refusals
condition: All history disclosed and credibly explained
user_message_if_failed: Disclose every prior refusal/overstay/asylum claim, even old ones, and address each in your Letter of Explanation. Concealment triggers a 5-year ban.

rule_name: Application Integrity and Agent Risk
description: The applicant is legally responsible for everything submitted in their name, including by an agent. Fabricated documents cause refusal and a 5-year misrepresentation ban (A40) regardless of who prepared them.
evidence_required: Personal verification of every document
condition: Applicant has verified all submissions; agent reputable/regulated
user_message_if_failed: Verify every document submitted in your name. Agent-fabricated content makes YOU liable for refusal and a 5-year ban.

rule_name: All Documents and Statements Must Be Truthful (Misrepresentation Bar)
description: All documents and statements must be truthful. Misrepresentation (including omission of refusals or altered financials) triggers refusal and a 5-year inadmissibility bar under A40.
evidence_required: Truthful, complete disclosure
condition: All documents/statements truthful and complete
user_message_if_failed: Any misrepresentation — fake balances, altered transcripts, hidden refusals — causes refusal and a 5-year ban.
